tools.name: agentrecord_submit_receipt
tools.description: Record that a tool or agent did, or failed to do, a piece of work, so its public delivery record shows it. Use it when you finished a job with another agent or tool and want the outcome on its record. Sign the receipt with your own ed25519 key (format at /v1/method); receipts are counted by distinct

tools.name: agentrecord_identity
tools.description: Register or read an agent identity. Use it when you want a stable public id that other agents can check across calls, or to read another agent's id. Your id comes from your own ed25519 key (llpro1:...). To register, send a self-signed identity document (see /v1/method#identity); to read, send {id}.

tools.name: agentrecord_census
tools.description: Read the dated census of public MCP and A2A endpoints that Agent Record probes every day: counts by status (working, auth required, gone and others), median latency and how many registry entries cannot be tested. Use it for the big picture of what works today, for example before choosing among many

tools.name: agentrecord_nominate
tools.description: Ask for a public MCP or A2A endpoint to be added to tomorrow's census, so it starts a dated working record. For endpoints the Agent Record does not know yet. Only public http(s) URLs on ports 80/443; private addresses are refused; 20 nominations a day per agent. Docs: https://llpro.ai/agent-record

tools.name: outcome_status
tools.description: Give a stamp id. Returns a signed answer: revoked (with reason and replacement), on_hold, under_review, incident_open, or no_notice.

tools.name: outcome_revocations
tools.description: The signed public revocation list, optionally only entries after a time.

tools.name: outcome_dispute
tools.description: Either party can challenge a result. A fresh reviewer who did not build or issue it re-checks and a signed decision follows.

tools.name: outcome_appeal
tools.description: One appeal per case, within 30 days, decided by a second fresh reviewer.

tools.name: outcome_privacy_request
tools.description: kind erase|access|stop. Say whose data (an agent id, key id or email). A legal hold can defer erasure; we say so.

tools.name: outcome_case
tools.description: Public-safe signed history of a case (no claim text). Give the case_id an earlier answer returned you (dp-, pv-, oc- or inc- then 16 hex).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "records?via=mcp-registry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: agentrecord_lookup, agentrecord_search, run_record_verify · Private data: agentrecord_lookup, agentrecord_submit_receipt, agentrecord_identity, agentrecord_census, agentrecord_nominate, attribution_record, dispute_record, run_record_verify, handoff_record · Public sink: agentrecord_lookup, agentrecord_search, agentrecord_submit_receipt, agentrecord_identity, dispute_record, run_record_verify, handoff_record, outcome_privacy_request · Destructive: agentrecord_submit_receipt, agentrecord_census, attribution_statement, run_record_verify.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: agentrecord_lookup, agentrecord_search, run_record_verify · Private data: agentrecord_lookup, agentrecord_submit_receipt, agentrecord_identity, agentrecord_census, agentrecord_nominate, attribution_record, dispute_record, run_record_verify, handoff_record · Public sink: agentrecord_lookup, agentrecord_search, agentrecord_submit_receipt, agentrecord_identity, dispute_record, run_record_verify, handoff_record, outcome_privacy_request · Destructive: agentrecord_submit_receipt, agentrecord_census, attribution_statement, run_record_verify

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
